name: Book of Ancient Secrets
description: Discover and transcribe additional Ritual spells of level no greater than half your Warlock level rounded up. Pay 50 gp and spend two hours per spell level. You can cast them as rituals through the active book; this does not add ordinary known spells or free nonritual casts. No additional starting pair is granted. Paid ritual records survive book replacement without adding new spells or restoring uses.
